pairs.name: pve01-host-debian13-nonetworkd
pairs.note: systemd-networkd is not running on this host (Proxmox VE manages networking via ifupdown/vmbr, not networkd) -- a real production fallback trigger, not a version cutoff. `networkctl --json=short list` exits 1 with EMPTY stdout (stderr-only warning + error, stripped here); `networkctl list --no-legend` exits 0 and still prints rows, but OPERATIONAL is shown as `-` for every link since networkd never populated it. Production's collectNetworkdLinks gates on the JSON call's exit code (err == nil), so this case falls back to text correctly today -- it exercises the fallback trigger but is not itself a divergence.
